facts.claim: The 'e-Permit' is only valid for visits to 'Gir Jungle Safari', 'GIZ Devalia Safari', 'Ambardi Safari Park', and 'Girnar Nature Safari'.
facts.subject: e_permit
facts.evidence: The 'e-Permit' is for a visit to 'Gir Jungle Safari', 'GIZ Devalia Safari', 'Ambardi Safari Park' and 'Girnar Nature Safari' only.

facts.claim: It is compulsory to carry the 'e-Permit' during reporting and entry time.
facts.subject: e_permit
facts.evidence: It is compulsory to carry the 'e-Permit' during reporting and entry time.

facts.claim: All visitors must carry their original photo identity proof (Aadhar Card/PAN Card/Driving Licence/Voter ID Card).
facts.subject: visitor
facts.evidence: All the visitors should carry their original photo identity proof (Aadhar Card/PAN Card/Driving Licence/Voter ID Card).

facts.claim: Foreigners must carry their original passport as the photo identity proof.
facts.subject: foreigner
facts.evidence: For FOREIGNER , it is compulsory to keep the original passport as the photo identity proof with him/her.

facts.claim: Entry will not be permitted for the safari without original photo identity proof.
facts.subject: entry
facts.evidence: Entry will not be permitted for the safari without original photo identity proof.

facts.claim: During the reporting time, the presence of each person is compulsory.
facts.subject: person
facts.evidence: During the reporting time, the presence of each person is compulsory.

facts.claim: One 'e-Permit' allows entry of a maximum of 6 adults + 1 child (3-12 years) to visit 'Gir Jungle Safari', 'GIZ Devalia Safari', 'Ambardi Safari Park', and 'Girnar Nature Safari' within the selected time slot on a particular route only.
facts.subject: e_permit
facts.evidence: One 'e-Permit' allows entry of a maximum of 6 adults + 1 child* (3-12 years) to visit 'Gir Jungle Safari', 'GIZ Devalia Safari', 'Ambardi Safari Park' and 'Girnar Nature Safari' within the selected time slot on a particular route only.

facts.claim: For Gir Jungle Safari and Girnar Nature Safari, one person can get only one 'e-Permit' per slot per day.
facts.subject: person
facts.evidence: For Gir Jungle Safari and Girnar Nature Safari, one person can get only one 'e-Permit' per slot per day.

facts.claim: 'GIZ Devalia Safari Park' remains closed every Wednesday.
facts.subject: giz_devalia_safari_park
facts.evidence: 'GIZ Devalia Safari Park' remain closed every Wednesday.

facts.claim: The e-permit does not include the Guide and Safari vehicle charge, which must be paid separately to respective Guides and Safari vehicle owners.
facts.subject: e_permit
facts.evidence: The e-permit doesn't includes the Guide and Safari vehicle charge,which must be paid separatley to respective Guides and Safari vehicle owners.

facts.claim: The Forest Department's concerned authorities reserve the full rights to change the time slot timings as per the weather/seasonal conditions or due to sudden, unavoidable circumstances.
facts.subject: forest_department
facts.evidence: The Forest Department's concerned authorities reserve the full rights to change the time slot timings as per the weather/seasonal conditions or due to sudden, unavoidable circumstances.

facts.claim: 'Gir Jungle Trail' and 'Girnar Nature Safari' can be booked only through the online booking system, and 'GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari' can be booked online as well as current booking if the permits are available.
facts.subject: booking
facts.evidence: 'Gir Jungle Trail' and 'Girnar Nature Safari' can be booked only through the online booking system, and 'GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari can be booked online as well as current booking if the permits are available.

facts.claim: For Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari, 'Ambardi Safari Park' and Girnar Nature Safari, online booking opens three months before the date and closes down two hours before the date.
facts.subject: online_booking
facts.evidence: For Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari, 'Ambardi Safari Park' and Girnar Nature Safari, online booking opens three months before the date. It closes down two hours before the date.

facts.claim: If one does not receive an e-Permit despite the successful financial transaction due to technical errors, a refund will be done in 15-20 working days.
facts.subject: e_permit
facts.evidence: If one does not receive an e-Permit despite the successful financial transaction due to technical errors, a refund will be done in 15-20 working days.

facts.claim: For such issues, kindly send an email to gslcsgir@yahoo.com or call us on 02877-285621.
facts.subject: gslcsgir
facts.evidence: For such issues, kindly send an email to gslcsgir@yahoo.com or call us on 02877-285621.

facts.claim: Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari, 'Ambardi Safari Park' and Girnar Nature Safari visitors are requested to arrive at the respective reception centres (boarding point) 30 minutes before the scheduled time mentioned in the e-Permit.
facts.subject: visitor
facts.evidence: Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari, 'Ambardi Safari Park' and Girnar Nature Safari visitors are requested to arrive at the respective reception centres (boarding point) 30 minutes before the scheduled time mentioned in the e-Permit.

facts.claim: If the late reporting at the boarding point, e-Permit will get cancelled, and no refund can be claimed.
facts.subject: e_permit
facts.evidence: If the late reporting at the boarding point, e-Permit will get cancelled, and no refund can be claimed.

facts.claim: The waitlist will be cleared only as per the cancellation.
facts.subject: waitlist
facts.evidence: The waitlist will be cleared only as per the cancellation.

facts.claim: An eco-guide will accompany the visitors during the safari, and eco-guide allocation will be done randomly by the concerned authority.
facts.subject: eco_guide
facts.evidence: An eco-guide will accompany the visitors during the safari, and eco-guide allocation will be done randomly by the concerned authority.

facts.claim: For the safari, each visitor's name, his/her identity card number and type of identity card should be mentioned during the online booking.
facts.subject: visitor
facts.evidence: For the safari, each visitor's name, his/her identity card number and type of identity card should be mentioned during the online booking

facts.claim: No other person than the registered visitor is allowed in the safari vehicle.
facts.subject: safari_vehicle
facts.evidence: No other person than the registered visitor is allowed in the safari vehicle.

facts.claim: Bookings with incomplete or incorrect I.D. proof will be considered invalid.
facts.subject: booking
facts.evidence: Bookings with incomplete or incorrect I.D. proof will be considered invalid.

facts.claim: No Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari, 'Ambardi Safari Park' and Girnar Nature Safari will be permitted against such bookings.
facts.subject: booking
facts.evidence: No Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari, 'Ambardi Safari Park' and Girnar Nature Safari will be permitted against such bookings.

facts.claim: No refund will be made for such cases.
facts.subject: booking
facts.evidence: No refund will be made for such cases.

facts.claim: All disputes and legal matters are subject to the jurisdiction of Junagadh district, Gujarat state only.
facts.subject: dispute
facts.evidence: All disputes and legal matters are subject to the jurisdiction of Junagadh district, Gujarat state only.

facts.claim: The services such as the issue of duplicate permits for lost/mutilated/torn permits and bulk booking for more than six people (for Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari and Girnar Nature Safari) will not be provided.
facts.subject: service
facts.evidence: The services such as the issue of duplicate permits for lost/mutilated/torn permits and bulk booking for more than six people (for Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari and Girnar Nature Safari) will not be provided.

facts.claim: Form-20 must be submitted online for registration of a new vehicle.
facts.subject: form_20
facts.evidence: Application in Form - 20 should be made for registration of a New Vehicle. It is compulsory to submit Form - 20 online on the web portal of the department.

facts.claim: A printout of Form-20 must be submitted at the concerned R.T.O. along with other necessary documents.
facts.subject: form_20_printout
facts.evidence: The print out of uploaded Form - 20 should be taken and should be submitted at the concerned R.T.O. along with other necessary documents.

facts.claim: A Sale Certificate in Form No.21 is required for vehicle registration.
facts.subject: sale_certificate
facts.evidence: Sale Certificate in Form No.21

facts.claim: A Road worthiness certificate in Form 22 is required for vehicle registration.
facts.subject: road_worthiness_certificate
facts.evidence: Road worthiness certificate in Form 22.

facts.claim: Identity proof with photographs of the applicant is required for vehicle registration.
facts.subject: identity_proof
facts.evidence: Identity proof with photographs of applicant.

facts.claim: Vehicle insurance certificate is required for vehicle registration.
facts.subject: vehicle_insurance
facts.evidence: Vehicle insurance certificate.

facts.claim: Proof of address is required for vehicle registration.
facts.subject: proof_of_address
facts.evidence: Proof of address

facts.claim: In case the vehicle is imported, a bill of entry submitted to Customs is required.
facts.subject: imported_vehicle
facts.evidence: In case vehicle is imported, then, bill of entry submitted to Customs and in case, vehicle is not a body built vehicle, then Form No.22 Part 2 (A) should also be submitted along with the application.

facts.claim: Passport, L.I.C. Policy, Electoral Voter I-Card, Light Bill, Telephone Bill, receipt of House Tax with address, Pay Slip of Central/State/Local self Government or an Affidavit from the applicant can be submitted as proof of address and identification.
facts.subject: proof_of_address
facts.evidence: Passport, L.I.C. Policy, Electoral Voter I-Card, Light Bill, Telephone Bill, receipt of House Tax with address, Pay Slip of Central/State/Local self Government or an Affidavit from the applicant to that effect can be submitted as a proof of address as well as proof of identification.

facts.claim: A new vehicle is registered in the R.T.O. where the vehicle owner ordinarily resides or has his place of business.
facts.subject: new_vehicle
facts.evidence: A new vehicle is registered in the R.T.O. where the vehicle owner ordinarily resides or has his place of business.

facts.claim: The inspection of two wheelers and car is permitted to be done by authorized dealer in the State.
facts.subject: vehicle_inspection
facts.evidence: The inspection of two wheelers and car is permitted to be done by authorized dealer in the State.

facts.claim: If the certificate is not issued by the dealer, the vehicle is required to be produced in R.T.O. for inspection.
facts.subject: vehicle_inspection
facts.evidence: In case, such certificate is issued by the dealer, the same should be attached with the application; otherwise the vehicle is required to be produced in R.T.O. for inspection.

facts.claim: If all papers attached to Form-20 are found correct, then a registration number is allocated to the vehicle.
facts.subject: form_20
facts.evidence: If, all papers attached to Form-20 are found correct, then, a registration number is allocated to the vehicle, Unless a selected number has been obtained by the owner paying appropriate fee, the vehicle registration number is allocated by computer through a random system after the registration process is completed.

facts.claim: The vehicle owner is informed about the registration number through SMS or E-Mail address submitted by them.
facts.subject: registration_number
facts.evidence: The vehicle owner is informed about the registration number through SMS or E-Mail address submitted by them.

facts.claim: The smart R.C. Book of the vehicle is sent by speed-post at the address indicated by the applicant in the Form.
facts.subject: smart_rc_book
facts.evidence: The smart R.C. Book of the vehicle is sent by speed-post at the address indicated by the applicant in the Form.

facts.claim: A fee of Rs.1000/- is required for two wheelers for choice number selection.
facts.subject: choice_number
facts.evidence: After public auction, the remaining numbers can be selected as choice number by paying a fee of Rs.1000/- for two wheelers and Rs.5000/- for four wheelers.

facts.claim: A fee of Rs.5000/- is required for four wheelers for choice number selection.
facts.subject: choice_number
facts.evidence: After public auction, the remaining numbers can be selected as choice number by paying a fee of Rs.1000/- for two wheelers and Rs.5000/- for four wheelers.

facts.claim: A fee of Rs.150/- is required for transfer of ownership of two wheelers.
facts.subject: transfer_ownership
facts.evidence: A fee of Rs.150/- in case of two wheelers and Rs.300/- in case of motor car is required to be paid as transfer fee.

facts.claim: A fee of Rs.300/- is required for transfer of ownership of motor cars.
facts.subject: transfer_ownership
facts.evidence: A fee of Rs.150/- in case of two wheelers and Rs.300/- in case of motor car is required to be paid as transfer fee.

facts.claim: A fee of Rs.200/- is required for entering or cancelling hypothecation details.
facts.subject: hypothecation_details
facts.evidence: A fee of Rs.200/- is required to be paid for this purpose.

facts.claim: A fee of Rs.150/- is required for a duplicate R.C. Book for motor cycles.
facts.subject: duplicate_rc_book
facts.evidence: A fee of Rs.150/- for motor cycle and a fee of Rs.300/- for motor car is required to be paid.

facts.claim: A fee of Rs.300/- is required for a duplicate R.C. Book for motor cars.
facts.subject: duplicate_rc_book
facts.evidence: A fee of Rs.150/- for motor cycle and a fee of Rs.300/- for motor car is required to be paid.

facts.claim: A vehicle brought from another state must be produced for compulsory inspection.
facts.subject: vehicle_from_other_state
facts.evidence: The vehicle is required to be produced compulsorily for inspection.

facts.claim: A declaration in Form F.T. must be made within 7 days if a vehicle is brought into the State permanently.
facts.subject: declaration_form_ft
facts.evidence: If a vehicle is brought in the State permanently, then the declaration in Form F.T. should be made within a period of 7 days.

facts.claim: A vehicle must be produced for inspection within 14 days of approval for change in vehicle.
facts.subject: vehicle_inspection
facts.evidence: vehicle should be produced for inspection within 14 days of such approval being given.

facts.claim: If you purchase a secondhand boiler from Gujarat or another state, you must inform the Boiler office.
facts.subject: change_in_ownership
facts.evidence:
Do I required to inform Boiler office if I purchase secondhand boiler from Gujarat or other state ?
A:
Yes, in case of change in ownership Boiler office shall be informed and necessary other formalities are required to be completed.

facts.claim: Buyers and sellers must submit a letter to the Director's office in Ahmedabad for change in ownership of a boiler.
facts.subject: change_in_ownership
facts.evidence:
what other formalities are to be carried out ?
A:
Buyers and sellers letter is to be submitted to Directors office at Ahemadabad.

facts.claim: To register a new boiler, an application with required fees and original maker's papers must be submitted to the concerned area office.
facts.subject: boiler_registration
facts.evidence:
I have purchased a new boiler what should I do ?
A:
An application with required fees ( paid in Govt. treasury through Chalan) and original makers papers is to be submitted to concerned area office.

facts.claim: The boiler registration fee is based on the heating surface area of the boiler and is as per Regulation 385 of IBR 1950.
facts.subject: boiler_registration
facts.evidence:
what is the Registration fee structure ?
A:
It is as per Regulation 385 of IBR 1950 . It is based on Heating surface area of your boiler.

facts.claim: The boiler inspection fee is as per Regulation 395A of IBR 1950.
facts.subject: boiler_inspection
facts.evidence:
What is Inspection fee structure ?
A:
It is as per Regulation 395A of IBR 1950.

facts.claim: The address and jurisdiction of the concerned Boiler department office can be found on the Boiler department website.
facts.subject: boiler_department_office
facts.evidence:
How I can get information of concern Boiler department office address with its jurisdiction ?
A:
It is available on Boiler department website
www.boiler.gujarat.gov.in

what is the procedure about steam line ?

www.boiler.gujarat.gov.in

facts.claim: To qualify as an IBR welder, one must meet the qualification and experience requirements mentioned in Regulation 608 of IBR 1950.
facts.subject: ibr_welder_qualification
facts.evidence:
Who is eligible to qualify as IBR welder ?
A:
Qualification & experience requirements is mentioned in Regulation 608 of IBR 1950. Those fulfilling these criterias are eligible to apply for welder qualification test.

facts.claim: An IBR welder can work freelance after getting the welder certificate, but must maintain records as per Regulation 615 of IBR 1950.
facts.subject: ibr_welder_freelance
facts.evidence:
Can a welder work fue lance after getting welder certificate. Yes, He has to maintain
records as per Reg.No. 615 of IBr-1950.

facts.claim: Before offering a welder qualification test, all materials like plate, pipe, tube of IBR quality and size as mentioned in Reg. 609 (B) of IBR-1950 must be ready with relevant material test certificates.
facts.subject: welder_qualification_test
facts.evidence:
What Preparation is needed before offering welder qualification test ?
A:
All materials like plate, pipe, tube of IBR quality &size as mentioned in Reg. 609 (B) of IBR-1950 is to be kept ready with relevant materials test certificate in original for verification.

facts.claim: There are two types of welder qualification tests: Initial welder qualification test and Welder RE-qualification test.
facts.subject: welder_qualification_test

detail.types: Initial welder qualification test, Welder RE-qualification test

facts.evidence:
What Type of welder test is conducted ?
A:
There is two type of welder qualification test
Initial welder qualification test
Welder RE-qualification test.

facts.claim: Form XII is a prescribed form as per IBR-1950 where all the details of a welder must be filled and submitted to the local IBR office.
facts.subject: form_xii
facts.evidence:
What is Form XII ?
A:
Form XII is prescribed form as per IBR-1950. All the Details of welder are to be filled in this form & submitted to local IBR office.

facts.claim: An IBR qualified welder from one state can work in another state after getting endorsement on the original welder certificate by the CIB of the other state and paying the endorsement fee as per Regulation 616.
facts.subject: ibr_welder_inter_state
facts.evidence:
Can a IBR qualified welder of one state, work in other state ?
A:
Yes, This is possible after getting endorsement on original welder certificate by CIB of other state. Endorsement fees as per regulation 616 is to be paid.

facts.claim: A fee must be paid in the Government Treasury and an original challan must be submitted to the IBR office for the welder qualification test.
facts.subject: welder_qualification_test
facts.evidence:
What is the fees/charges to be paid for welder qualification test ?
A:
A fees of Rs. Is to be paid in Govt. Tresary and original challan is required to be submitted in IBR office.

facts.claim: A NOC for a boiler is issued by the Boiler office if the boiler meets the conditions mentioned in section 2(b) of the Boiler Act-1923.
facts.subject: boiler_noc
facts.evidence:
Can I get NOC of My Boiler ?
A:
Boiler office issues NOC of a Particular Boiler if it meets the condition as mentioned in section 2(b) of Boiler Act-1923.

facts.claim: To apply for a NOC, the following documents must be submitted: filled Annexure form, fees paid through Treasurychallan of Rs. 800/-, and three copies of boiler drawings stating its volumetric capacity, pressure, etc., signed by the owner.
facts.subject: noc_application
facts.evidence:
Which documents are required to accompany NOC application ?
A:
Filled Annexure form
Fees paid through Tresurychallan of Rs. 800/-
Boiler Drawings (3 copies) stating its volumetric capacity, pressure etc. (signed by Owner)

facts.claim: A volumetric test of a boiler is conducted by a Boiler inspector to ensure the boiler's capacity is less than the limit.
facts.subject: volumetric_test
facts.evidence:
What is Volumetric Test ?
A:
Volumetric test of a Boiler is conducted by Boiler inspector to ensure that Boiler in questions capacity less than as let. It is actually conducted on Boiler.

facts.claim: NOC is not valid for life; it must be reissued after conducting a volumetric test or if the boiler pressure parts are changed, modified, or altered.
facts.subject: noc_validity
facts.evidence:
Is the NOC id valid for life time ?
A:
NOC is required to be Re issued after conducting volumetric test of coil / or Boiler pressure parts is changed modified of altered.

facts.evidence: “Wellness Resort” means a New Tourism Project or Expansion of Tourism Project to setup a NABH-accredited wellness center, having accommodation and offering a range of wellness services, The wellness services shall aim towards rejuvenation, rehabilitation, improving immunity and may include but not limited to Ayurvedic, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy, Acupressure, Acupuncture, and any other alternative therapies, except allopathy-based treatment.

facts.claim: A wellness resort must have accommodation, landscaped green open spaces, and a variety of wellness services.
facts.subject: wellness_resort
facts.evidence: The Wellness Resort must have of following facilities: a. Accommodation; b. Landscaped green open spaces; and c. A variety of wellness services

facts.claim: Standalone units like gyms, spas, and fitness centers are not eligible under the wellness resort category.
facts.subject: wellness_resort
facts.evidence: Standalone units like Gymnasiums, Spas, Skincare Centers, Cosmetic Care Centers, Fitness Centers, Immunization Centers, Health Checkup Centres and Hospitals are not eligible under this category.

facts.claim: An apartment hotel must have a minimum capital investment of INR 50.00 lakh.
facts.subject: apartment_hotel
facts.evidence: “Apartment Hotel” means a New or Expansion of an existing “Apartment Hotel” Project. The minimum Capital Investment should be of INR 50.00 Lakh and such Apartment Hotel(s) should also obtain necessary category certification from Ministry of Tourism, Government of India as per guidelines issued from time to time.

facts.claim: A tented accommodation must conform to the standards issued by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India.
facts.subject: tented_accommodation
facts.evidence: “Tented Accommodation” means a New Tourism Project confirming to the standards as per guidelines issued for Classification of Tented Accommodation” by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India from time to time.

facts.claim: A tented accommodation must remain in operation for a minimum period of ninety days every year for five years from the date of commencement of commercial operations.
facts.subject: tented_accommodation
facts.evidence: These Tented Accommodation(s) must remain in operational for a minimum period of ninety days every year for a period of five years from the Date of Commencement of Commercial Operations.

facts.claim: A container accommodation must have facilities at least equivalent to the guidelines for tented accommodation issued by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India.
facts.subject: container_accommodation
facts.evidence: “Container Accommodation” means a New Tourism Project having facilities at least equivalent to the “Guidelines for Project Approval and Classification of Tented Accommodation” and any such subsequent revisions or amendments as and when released by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India from time to time.

facts.claim: A bhunga, cottage, or log hut must have facilities at least equivalent to the one-star hotel category as per the revised guidelines issued by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India.
facts.subject: bhunga_cottage_log_hut
facts.evidence: “Bhunga/ Cottage/ Log hut” means a New Tourism Project having facilities at least equivalent to the one-star hotel category as per “Revised Guidelines for Approval of Hotels at Project Stage and Star Classification /Re-classification of Operational Hotels, No. 8-TH-I (3)/2013-Pt- 1, dated: 19.01.2018” and any such subsequent revisions or amendments as and when released by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India from time to time.

facts.claim: A houseboat must remain in operation for a minimum period of six months every year for five years from the date of commencement of commercial operations.
facts.subject: houseboat
facts.evidence: Houseboat shall remain in operation for a minimum period of six months every year for a period of five years from the Date of Commencement of Commercial Operations.

facts.claim: A motel must have a minimum capital investment of INR 50.00 lakh.
facts.subject: motel
facts.evidence: “Motel” means a New Motel Tourism unit or Expansion of Motel Tourism unit with a minimum Capital Investment of INR 50.00 Lakh and obtain necessary category certification from Ministry of Tourism, Government of India as per guidelines issued from time to time.

facts.claim: Wayside amenities must have a minimum capital investment of INR 50.00 lakh.
facts.subject: wayside_amenities
facts.evidence: “Wayside Amenities” means a New or Expansion of Tourism Project with a minimum Capital Investment of INR 50.00 Lakh and established as per the “Guidelines for Wayside Amenities, No. TRS/NPT/WAYSIDE AMENITIES/2020-21/131, dated: 04.08.2020” of Government of Gujarat and any such subsequent revisions or amendments as and when released by Government of Gujarat from time to time.

facts.claim: A theme park must have a minimum capital investment of INR 50.00 crore.
facts.subject: theme_park
facts.evidence: “Theme Park” means a recreational tourism project either a New or an Expansion having facilities including but not limited to amusement rides/adventure rides/ water rides and accommodation units etc. All such theme parks shall obtain prior approval from the SLIC and shall make a minimum Capital Investment of INR 50.00 Cr.

facts.claim: An integrated tourism destination theme park must have a minimum capital investment of INR 500.00 crore.
facts.subject: integrated_tourism_destination_theme_park
facts.evidence: “Integrated Tourism Destination Theme Park” means a multi tourism project-based integrated tourism project for amusement, entertainment, and accommodation of tourists and offer multiple facilities/ activities of tourist attraction at one location with Capital Investment of INR 500.00 Cr.

facts.claim: A convention center must have a hall with a minimum seating capacity of 2,500 persons and a vehicle parking facility for not less than 250 cars and 10 coaches/buses.
facts.subject: convention_centre
facts.evidence: “Convention Centre” means a New Tourism Project having facilities to hold Meetings, Corporate events, Convocations, and Exhibitions with one hall with a minimum seating capacity of 2,500 persons and a vehicle parking facility for not less than 250 cars and 10 coaches/buses.
